limitations: Only one new source training data world; source seeds are conditional replications, not five independent data worlds.
Same eight source task sets and four targets as before; new training and target inputs, not new mathematical domains.
Single and multi-task source losses have different gradient objectives; per-task exposure, sample schedule, initialization and optimizer are held fixed.
Five seed confidence intervals are descriptive and sensitive to few replications.
Incremental relation prediction is conditional on the eight selected groups, not a causal test of relation structure.
